title: Gun model info (glTF root node extras.info)
description: Metres. The glTF frame (x = right, y = up, z = -forward) with the origin at the gun's own origin (the point the recipe builds around: roughly the back of the receiver on the bore line). Every anchor in `info` is written [forward, up, right] = [-z, y, x]; a node's transform is in the same frame, so a part is built "in place" and its node origin is only its pivot. Generated from js/glb.ts INFO_FIELDS: do not edit (npm run check:models -- --write).

fSight.description: Forward position of the front sight (or the sight's front), metres: with sy and relief it places the aiming eye.

muzzles.description: Where the bullet leaves, one [forward, up, right] metres entry per barrel (usually one; an over/under has two, a barrel block more): never assume [0] is the only one. The flash, tracers and shot start here. A part may provide them (GUN_MODEL_CONTRACT.anchors).

oneOf.description: A gun with several barrels, each holding a stack of rounds fired nose to tail: n barrels (info.muzzles has one entry each, in the same order). The ROUND LENGTH loaded decides how many rounds a barrel holds, so the model lists the round types it takes in `rounds`, keyed by name (standard, rifle...): each has rounds_each (the rounds a barrel holds of that type), effective_mm (the length the bullet has run down the bore for the 1st, 2nd... last round of a barrel: rounds_each entries, longest last: the more rounds are gone, the longer the run) and round_mm [diameter, length] of one round (informational). `default` names the type a gun starts with. stack_mm is the length of a barrel's stack (the same for every type: a longer round, fewer of them) and free_bore_mm the part of the bore a fresh barrel has before its first round (both informational). The game takes the speed of a shot from the effective length (GUN_MODEL_CONTRACT.multi).

barrels.description: A gun with several barrels, each holding a stack of rounds fired nose to tail: n barrels (info.muzzles has one entry each, in the same order). The ROUND LENGTH loaded decides how many rounds a barrel holds, so the model lists the round types it takes in `rounds`, keyed by name (standard, rifle...): each has rounds_each (the rounds a barrel holds of that type), effective_mm (the length the bullet has run down the bore for the 1st, 2nd... last round of a barrel: rounds_each entries, longest last: the more rounds are gone, the longer the run) and round_mm [diameter, length] of one round (informational). `default` names the type a gun starts with. stack_mm is the length of a barrel's stack (the same for every type: a longer round, fewer of them) and free_bore_mm the part of the bore a fresh barrel has before its first round (both informational). The game takes the speed of a shot from the effective length (GUN_MODEL_CONTRACT.multi).

oneOf.description: The shape of its motion on the way out (default smooth): smooth (eased in and out), linear, in (speeding up), out (slowing down), spring (released: a sharp start, past the end by over, settled back; the gun kicks), detent (a firm pull: it creeps, holds at a detent, then gives and drops onto its stop; the hand leads, the gun dips with the effort), heavy (a weight lifted: slow, the gun sagging under it and recovering), magnet (drawn in: speeding up all the way, then a soft, damped stop with no bounce).

ease.description: The shape of its motion on the way out (default smooth): smooth (eased in and out), linear, in (speeding up), out (slowing down), spring (released: a sharp start, past the end by over, settled back; the gun kicks), detent (a firm pull: it creeps, holds at a detent, then gives and drops onto its stop; the hand leads, the gun dips with the effort), heavy (a weight lifted: slow, the gun sagging under it and recovering), magnet (drawn in: speeding up all the way, then a soft, damped stop with no bounce).

oneOf.description: The support hand during the step: on part (a part_ node) at at, [forward, up, right] metres in that node's own frame (it moves with it). Without one the hand stays where the step before had it.

hand.description: The support hand during the step: on part (a part_ node) at at, [forward, up, right] metres in that node's own frame (it moves with it). Without one the hand stays where the step before had it.

oneOf.description: A sequence of moves that takes the gun apart for a reload (the Tempest changes its whole barrel block): each step moves one part_ node, in order; the reload animation plays them forward (the old block comes out) and back (the new one goes in). part: the node (its key, "lever", or its name "part_lever"); rotate_deg turns it about axis x, y or z (three.js rotation, degrees) at its pivot; move slides it [forward, up, right] metres, in the frame of the part_ node named by frame (default: its own parent's). How each step FEELS is data too (all optional): share, its part of the time (relative to the other steps, default 1); ease, the shape of its motion on the way out; over, a spring's overshoot; back { share, ease }, the same for the way back (default: the way out's share, smooth); hand { part, at }, where the support hand holds the gun during the step (a point of that part_ node, [forward, up, right] metres in its own frame: the hand moves with the part). GUN_MODEL_CONTRACT.multi.
